translation_notes: IDENTITY TRANSLATION of the region: no island applies. The two RDF ops the metric counts are Graph(self, URIRef(uri)) and that URIRef itself, and both resist the notation

URIRef(uri) is deliberately NOT rewritten as f<{uri}>: it casts a value that is already a complete IRI coming back from the database, whereas f<...> is an IRI *template* resolved against the in-scope @base; the two coincide here only because no @base is declared and the value is absolute

the whole point of the region is SPARQL/SQL built by %-formatting into a Python string ('SELECT DISTINCT ?g WHERE { GRAPH ?g { %(S)s %(P)s %(O)s } }' + n3() of each term). String contents are opaque to the island parser, so a store implementation that assembles query text stays entirely untouched - a clear negative result for a 'graph_ctor + term_constructor' region

context shim: vstore_ctx.py holds _query_bindings/_bnode_to_nodeid copied verbatim from the source file (BSD-3), plus FakeVirtuosoStore, an rdflib Store stand-in that records the query text and replays a fixed row set instead of talking to Virtuoso over ODBC; used identically by both sides

demo harness added identically to both sides: contexts() is a generator, so it is driven over three cases (no statement, a statement pattern, a store with quad_storage set - all three branches) and the pair compared on stdout: yielded graph identifiers and the exact query text sent to the cursor
